outputs.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the 141 samples is plotted as an individual point; marginal histograms show distributions of raw data. Scatter plots are exempt from this check.

Scatter plot where each point represents an individual sample (mean ± s.d. of technical/biological replicates per reporter); scatter plots are exempt from requiring further overlay of individual points.
Density/normal distribution curves (line plots) of periods and amplitudes; line plots are exempt from this check.
Box plot of CWT ridge lengths; box plots are exempt by type, and individual sample points (Per2-Luc, Bmal1-Luc dots) are additionally overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histogram bars show phase differences averaged across multiple replicates per cell line, but no individual replicate data points are overlaid on the bars.
Polar histogram bars show phase differences averaged across cell line models per subtype, but no individual cell-line data points are shown overlaid on the bars.
Line plot showing a single example signal trace with fitted decay model; not an aggregate/average plot, and line plots are exempt from this check.
Scatter plot where each of the 117 samples is shown as an individual point with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from this check.
